title: Two Goldman questions, worked through
subtitle: How to think through a question that asks for three things at once, and a project question that wants a story.

points.head: A long question is a list.
points.text: Find the verbs. Each verb is one thing to answer.

points.head: Answer in the order asked.
points.text: Open each part with a few of the question's own words.

points.head: A story has an order, not a name.
points.text: You never say STAR. You tell what happened.

how: Coloured boxes show example words. Grey is a weak answer, green is a strong one, blue is a line to say out loud.
Square brackets mark things only you know. Fill them in your own words.
